name: Baksan BUST
summary: Long-running underground liquid-scintillator neutrino telescope constraining annihilation of captured WIMPs through upward-going muons from the Sun.
detection_principle: Layered liquid scintillator measures directions of traversing muons, selecting neutrino-induced upward-going events for comparison with atmospheric-neutrino backgrounds.

status.label: Operation supported by evidence
status.evidence: 2012 dark-matter paper and current institutional project page; the latest dedicated data period has not been verified.

collaboration.name: Baksan BUST collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Only examples of lead or participating institutions directly established by the sources are listed. This is not a complete collaboration list, and listing does not imply equal institutional roles.

key_parameters.name: Target
key_parameters.value: About 330 t of liquid scintillator, 3180 modules

results.summary: No excess was found toward the Sun; results were converted to spin-dependent WIMP–proton scattering limits.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
